notes.title: Patch 1.1.2!
notes.content:
The version 1.1.2 is here! It features mostly visual changes, with some additional bugfixes (most importantly, getting rid off the progression blocker in the Elevator scene). The next patch, unless something very urgent comes up, will be the main part of the Exhibition (1.2.0) update. I'll be adding a new area to explore (the titular exhibition) as well as some more QoL changes – key binding remapping, among others.

Cheers!

tags.bug: - getting rid off the progression blocker in the Elevator scene

notes.title: Polish&Polish (1.1.0) – now live!
notes.content:
Hi! 

I'm happy to say that the Polish&Polish update is (finally) here! Took a few days longer than I anticipated, but is well worth the wait, methinks.

So, the changes:
[list]
[*] Added full Polish voice over
[*] Reworked and rebuilt lighting in all levels (more light sources, more dynamic appearance, higher fidelity)
[*] Added/reworked some areas and objects to the levels
[*] Memory optimizations
[*] Localized the "Loading..." string
[*] Added a prompt whenether the game is saved
[*] Fixed a bug causing highlighted Memory lines to display improperly
[*] Tweaked how the final sequence unfolds musically
[*] Added an option to invert the camera's Y-axis 
[*] Changed the way initial dialogue activates in several scenes
[*] Increased pauses between staged dialogue segments
[*] Fixed UVs of several objects
[*] Added missing colliders to several scenes
[*] Added graffiti to a few scenes
[*] Other, minor bugfixes
[/list]

Cheers!
